product_overview: Vestry Hub is a multi-tenant church management platform for admins and members. It supports church operations like member management, giving, events, sermons, announcements, and member portal access while keeping each church’s data isolated by tenant.
core_goals: Allow church admins to sign in and set up their church account
Help admins manage members, groups, events, giving, sermons, livestreams, and announcements
Provide members with portal access to view church updates, events, sermons, and giving
Enable members to submit online donations through the portal
Support tenant-isolated church administration and member experiences

features.name: Admin Authentication
features.description: Allows church admins to sign up and sign in before accessing admin features.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/signin -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit sign-in form -> See admin dashboard
Navigate to /auth/signin -> Open the sign-up page -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit sign-up form -> See account setup confirmation
Navigate to /auth/signin -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit sign-in form -> See login error message

features.name: Church Onboarding
features.description: Guides an authenticated admin through initial church setup.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding -> Enter church name -> Select country -> Select currency -> Upload church logo -> Complete setup wizard -> See onboarding completion

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Shows an admin summary of church activity and key statistics.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View member count statistics -> View giving statistics -> View upcoming events -> View recent activity feed -> Open quick actions

features.name: Member Management
features.description: Lets admins create, review, update, search, and remove church members.
user_flows: Navigate to /members -> View members list -> Search members -> Filter members -> Add new member -> Save member details -> See the new member in the list
Navigate to /members -> Open a member profile -> Edit member details -> Save changes -> Return to the updated profile
Navigate to /members -> Open a member profile -> Delete member -> Confirm deletion -> See the member removed from the list

features.name: Group Management
features.description: Lets admins create and manage church groups and assign members to them.
user_flows: Navigate to /groups -> View groups list -> Create new group -> Save group details -> See the new group in the list
Navigate to /groups -> Open a group -> Add members to group -> Save changes -> See updated group membership
Navigate to /groups -> Open a group -> Remove members from group -> Save changes -> See updated group membership

features.name: Event Management
features.description: Lets admins create and update church events and configure registration details.
user_flows: Navigate to /events -> View events calendar -> Create new event -> Enter event details -> Set event capacity -> Set registration settings -> Save event -> See the event on the calendar
Navigate to /events -> Open an event -> Edit event details -> Save changes -> See updated event information
Navigate to /events -> Open an event -> Review RSVPs -> See attendee responses

features.name: Giving Management
features.description: Lets admins review giving records, record donations, filter transactions, and export reports.
user_flows: Navigate to /giving-records -> View giving records -> Filter by date range -> Filter by giving type -> Export giving report -> See downloaded report
Navigate to /giving-records -> Record manual donation -> Enter donation details -> Save donation -> See donation in giving records
Navigate to /give-online -> Select giving amount -> Choose giving type -> Enter payment details -> Submit donation -> See donation confirmation

features.name: Announcements
features.description: Allows admins to create, update, and control visibility of church announcements.
user_flows: Navigate to /announcements -> View announcements list -> Create new announcement -> Enter announcement details -> Save announcement -> See announcement in the list
Navigate to /announcements -> Open an announcement -> Edit announcement -> Save changes -> See updated announcement
Navigate to /announcements -> Open an announcement -> Publish announcement -> Set visibility -> See announcement marked as published
Navigate to /announcements -> Open an announcement -> Unpublish announcement -> Save changes -> See announcement marked as unpublished

features.name: Sermon Management
features.description: Lets admins upload and organize sermons with notes, transcripts, and series groupings.
user_flows: Navigate to /sermons -> View sermons list -> Upload new sermon -> Enter sermon details -> Add sermon notes -> Add transcript -> Save sermon -> See the sermon in the list
Navigate to /sermons -> Open a sermon -> Edit sermon details -> Save changes -> See updated sermon information
Navigate to /sermons -> Open a sermon -> Organize sermon by series -> Save changes -> See sermon grouped with its series

features.name: Live Streaming
features.description: Lets admins configure and manage livestream sessions and related prayer requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /livestreaming -> Configure streaming platforms -> Schedule a live stream -> Save schedule -> See the stream in the upcoming list
Navigate to /livestreaming -> Start live stream -> View stream as active -> Monitor streaming analytics -> Manage prayer requests during the stream
Navigate to /livestreaming -> Stop live stream -> See the stream marked as ended

features.name: Member Portal Authentication
features.description: Allows members to sign in to the member portal.
user_flows: Navigate to /member/login -> Enter member credentials -> Submit login form -> See member portal home
Navigate to /member/login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See login error message
Navigate to /member/login -> Reset password if needed -> Return to login page

features.name: Member Portal Home
features.description: Shows members a personalized portal with church updates and shortcuts.
user_flows: Navigate to /member -> View personal dashboard -> See upcoming events -> See recent announcements -> Open quick actions

features.name: Member Giving
features.description: Lets members submit online donations and review their giving history.
user_flows: Navigate to /member/give -> Select giving amount -> Choose giving type -> Enter payment details -> Submit donation -> See donation confirmation
Navigate to /member/give -> View giving history -> Review past donations

features.name: Church Settings
features.description: Lets admins update church information, communications preferences, roles, integrations, and giving configuration.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Update church information -> Save changes -> See updated church details
Navigate to /settings -> Configure communication settings -> Save changes -> See updated communication preferences
Navigate to /settings -> Manage user roles and permissions -> Save changes -> See updated access settings
Navigate to /settings -> Set up integrations -> Save changes -> See updated integration settings
Navigate to /settings -> Configure giving settings -> Save changes -> See updated giving configuration
